items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: He played with the Carl Hopkins band out of New York.

ctx.x: He's still playing. He played with the Carl Hopkins band out of New York. I believe he was playing in California with Dixieland. No, is he?
No, in New York. In New York. In New York? I think he lives in Connecticut. Well, he's in Connecticut.
